collectorCopy.status: AI paraphrase draft for collector review
collectorCopy.text: My eye kept returning to these works. I found myself looking for patterns, and for the feeling in each image. Some seemed joyous; others felt angry. That range kept me looking.

references.title: nnxyz nifty faces #25
references.reading: The face is less a contained form than an outward burst: pale lines spike in every direction, making the boundary between face and background hard to fix. A wide, tooth-filled mouth anchors the lower half with hard black outlines, while the eyes above are nearly lost in the same radiating tangle. The effect reads as overwhelming exuberance, though the near-erasure of the eyes gives that feeling an unsettled edge.
references.context: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nifty faces #24 and nnxyz nifty faces #26. Both neighbors use hard rectangular outlines and spiral or cross-marked eyes; this piece replaces that geometry with an all-over radial burst, making it the most boundary-dissolving face in this owned trio.

connections.reason: nnxyz nifty faces #24 shares the wide tooth-filled mouth and layered multicolor lines, but its face is held inside a hard rectangular border—a direct contrast to the radiating, borderless form here.
connections.selectionBasis: Both original PNGs supplied to multimodal drafting and separate image review; an editorial comparison, not evidence of influence

connections.reason: nnxyz nifty faces #26 also features circular eye marks and a prominent mouth, but its face is boxed in rigid outlines with flat color fills, making the uncontained spiking lines of this work stand out by contrast.
connections.selectionBasis: Both original PNGs supplied to multimodal drafting and separate image review; an editorial comparison, not evidence of influence

references.title: nnxyz nifty faces #72
references.reading: White patches assemble a skull-like face, while red and pale outlines keep its edges unsettled. The teeth are drawn as repeated loops rather than one solid band, making the grin feel insistent. The black ground removes distractions. It can read as confrontational or darkly comic; the image does not fix a single emotion.
references.context: Owned title-family neighbors: nnxyz nifty faces #71, nnxyz nifty faces #73. This is near the low end of recorded stroke count in Faces, yet its long sampled lines make that count a poor shorthand for visual detail.

connections.reason: Both assemble a toothy, skull-like head from overlapping marks. Compare the restricted red, white and black of Faces #72 with the many-colored overlays and glasses in nnxyz #1.
connections.selectionBasis: Both original images inspected by the assistant; AI editorial comparison, not evidence of artistic influence

references.title: nnxyz nifty faces #113
references.reading: A face appears without an enclosing outline: large circular eyes, a small curved nose and a round open mouth are enough to establish it. Overlapping pink, peach and pale yellow circles suggest a loose crown of hair. Their softness plays against the dark arcs below. The expression can suggest surprise, amusement or a moment of puzzled attention.
references.context: Owned title-family neighbors: nnxyz nifty faces #112, nnxyz nifty faces #114. The short point record and circular forms make a useful counterpoint to the long, unsettled contours in Faces #72. A shared series does not require a shared graphic vocabulary.

connections.reason: Both leave a large open field around a character assembled from rounded shapes. The face in #113 is mostly outlined; the figure in NNOTB #62 is mostly filled.
connections.selectionBasis: Both original images inspected by the assistant; AI editorial comparison, not evidence of artistic influence

references.title: nnxyz nnotb #62
references.reading: A small rounded figure sits at the lower right of a broad yellow square. Yellow marks pick out its eyes and stitched-looking grin from the black silhouette. The generous white frame and open field give this modest character unusual presence. Its apparent friendliness is complicated by the fixed smile; the expression remains available to more than one reading.
references.context: Owned title-family neighbors: nnxyz nnotb #61, nnxyz nnotb #63. This sits toward the low end of NNOTB stroke count. Its large open areas provide a useful contrast to the crowded drawing of NNOTB #1 fork, rather than an index of lesser effort.

connections.reason: Both use a framed field and a largely black, rounded figure. NNOTB #62 occupies a small corner; the curved body in Rawblocks #39 fills most of its frame.
connections.selectionBasis: Both original images inspected by the assistant; AI editorial comparison, not evidence of artistic influence

references.title: nnxyz rawblocks #39
references.reading: A black body bends inward against nested olive and yellow-green fields. A white eye and the broad white shape inside the bent arm interrupt its heavy silhouette. The projecting head marks add a prickly edge to an otherwise rounded figure. The pose can suggest absorbed thought or guardedness, but the few facial cues leave its mood unresolved.
references.context: Owned title-family neighbors: nnxyz rawblocks #38, nnxyz rawblocks #40. This has the smallest recorded stroke count among the owned Rawblocks. That describes the record, not its importance: broad filled forms carry most of the composition.

connections.reason: Both organize a dark rounded figure within a frame, using relatively few recorded strokes. Their very different occupied space makes the comparison more useful than the count alone.
connections.selectionBasis: Both original images inspected by the assistant; AI editorial comparison, not evidence of artistic influence

references.title: Scrimshaw 21
references.reading: A tilted head is built from angular, overlapping marks on a bright yellow ground. The eyes, nose and toothy mouth remain readable even as their contours multiply. Above them, long strokes fan outward and carry the face's restless energy into the surrounding space. The image holds exuberance and strain together rather than settling into a single expression.
references.context: Owned title-family neighbors: Scrimshaw 18, Scrimshaw 24. The related scrimshaw collection is a separate artist grouping. Its repeated facial contours give a concrete visual basis for the collector's connection with nnxyz, without establishing contact or influence between the artists.

connections.reason: Both use overlapping marks to keep a frontal head recognizable while unsettling its contours. Compare the broad, angular strokes here with the many fine crossings and glasses in nnxyz #1.
connections.selectionBasis: Both original images inspected by the assistant; AI editorial comparison, not evidence of artistic influence

prompts.collection:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished desktop website design concept screenshot, landscape 1536x1152, for nnxyz.thingelstad.xyz, a private collector's public museum-like gallery of 574 owned digital drawings (548 nnxyz, 26 related artist scrimshaw). This is a reviewable concept before implementation. It must show the real browsing experience including the top introduction AND artwork browsing continuation, not just a marketing hero.
Input images 1-5 are existing original artworks, to be inserted faithfully as square art reproductions; do not invent alternative artworks, recolor them, crop their edges or redraw them into a different style. Their order: Faces #25 dense multicolor grinning head, Faces #72 black/red/white skull, NNOTB #62 black little figure within a yellow and white frame, Rawblocks #39 olive nested fields with dark rounded figure, Scrimshaw 21 energetic tilted head on yellow.
Design direction: true pure white #FFFFFF canvas, near-black type, quiet gray secondary labels, exceptionally refined independent museum / editorial publication. Artwork is the main color. No cream, shadows, rounded cards, device bezel, marketing graphics, decorative badges, gradients, pills or extra icons. Use tasteful bookish serif for the main title and a precise clean sans-serif for navigation, captions, controls. Generous but practical whitespace, open image grid, precise baseline alignment, crisp readable text. Full uncropped square artworks, same size, placed directly on the white page with captions below, no card wrappers. All eventual text and controls will be code native; this screenshot is a design reference only.
Header: understated lowercase text wordmark "nnxyz" left; right navigation "Collection" (active with thin underline), "Curated walks", "About". No search box in header.
Opening below header: large serif headline left "A collection of nnxyz". To its right a modest 3-line collector introduction, exact copy "My eye kept returning to these works. I found myself looking for patterns, and for the feeling in each image. Some seemed joyous; others felt angry. That range kept me looking." This copy is an AI paraphrase draft for collector review, not a verbatim quote; do not draw quotation marks or invent collector name.
Under opening a slim single-line browse row with "All works" active then "Faces", "NNOTB", "Rawblocks", "Other nnxyz", "Scrimshaw". On the far right quiet "574 works" and an understated "Find a work" search affordance.
First art row: three large equal square reproductions: original image 1 Faces #25, original image 3 NNOTB #62, original image 4 Rawblocks #39. At least 340px square each with 40px gutters. Readable caption "Nifty Faces #25" / "NNOTB #62" / "Rawblocks #39", small artist "nnxyz", and small unfilled heart kudos affordance WITHOUT fabricated numeric count. Do not put play buttons over artwork; a discreet caption link "Watch drawing" can appear on first item only. Start of second art row visible below showing image 2 Faces #72 and image 5 Scrimshaw 21, establishing enjoyable scrolling continuation. Art should occupy most of lower viewport. Keep header/intro relatively short so visitors immediately see works. No repeated labels masquerading as art; no full sidebar; no decorative editorial extra sections. Output only the finished screenshot.
